overview.en: Lethrinus laticaudis Alleyne & Macleay, 1877 is a western Pacific emperor, recorded from southern Indonesia and northern Australia to Papua New Guinea and the Solomon Islands.
overview.fr: Lethrinus laticaudis Alleyne et Macleay, 1877 est un empereur du Pacifique occidental, signalé du sud de l’Indonésie et du nord de l’Australie jusqu’à la Papouasie-Nouvelle-Guinée et aux îles Salomon.

identification.en: It has a tan, brown or yellow body with irregular dark blotches; blue dots and short blue lines often mark the cheeks and head. It reaches about 56 cm total length.
identification.fr: Son corps beige, brun ou jaune porte des taches sombres irrégulières ; des points et de courtes lignes bleus marquent souvent les joues et la tête. Il atteint environ 56 cm de longueur totale.

habitat.en: Juveniles use seagrass beds and mangrove swamps, while adults are found mainly over coral reefs.
habitat.fr: Les jeunes fréquentent les herbiers marins et les mangroves, tandis que les adultes se rencontrent surtout au-dessus des récifs coralliens.

diet.en: Its diet consists mainly of crustaceans and fishes.
diet.fr: Son alimentation se compose surtout de crustacés et de poissons.

behavior.en: It is often observed in schools, according to the FAO account.
behavior.fr: Il est souvent observé en bancs, selon le compte rendu de la FAO.

reproduction.en: The species accounts consulted do not provide a spawning calendar specific to L. laticaudis.
reproduction.fr: Les comptes rendus consultés ne donnent pas de calendrier de ponte propre à L. laticaudis.

ecology.en: Like Lethrinus microdon, it is an Indo-Pacific emperor, but their reported habitats differ: juvenile grass emperors use seagrass and mangroves, whereas smalltooth emperors are reported over sand near reefs.
ecology.fr: Comme Lethrinus microdon, il s’agit d’un empereur de l’Indo-Pacifique, mais leurs habitats signalés diffèrent : les jeunes empereurs des herbiers fréquentent les herbiers et les mangroves, tandis que l’empereur tidents est signalé sur le sable près des récifs.

conservation.en: FishBase lists a 2015 IUCN assessment of Least Concern.
conservation.fr: FishBase indique une évaluation UICN de 2015 en préoccupation mineure.

title.fr: Lethrinus laticaudis — catalogue FAO des empereurs

facts: FAO reports juvenile seagrass and mangrove use, adult reef habitat, diet, schooling and a 56 cm maximum; its catalogue also describes L. microdon over sand near reefs.

facts: FishBase records range, appearance and size and lists the 2015 IUCN assessment; it gives no spawning calendar.

facts: The Australian National Fish Collection and Museums Victoria list Grass Emperor as a standard name and place L. laticaudis in genus Lethrinus and family Lethrinidae.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

uncertainties: No species-specific spawning information was found in the species accounts consulted. The French common name is a descriptive translation of Grass emperor; FAO's species sheet gives English, Spanish and local names but no standardized French name.
review_note: Cross-checked FAO species account, FishBase's French-interface page and the Australian fish collection portal; the reciprocal L. microdon comparison is limited to documented genus membership and habitat.
